steps.say: Hello students! Aaj hum Green's Theorem ke baare mein seekhne wale hain.
Green's Theorem ka purpose hai line integral ko double integral mein convert karna.
Statement samajhte hain: agar P aur Q continuous functions hain bounded region mein, toh theorem yeh kehti hai.
Yeh theorem sirf closed curve ke liye valid hoti hai, open curve ke liye nahi.
Diagram dekhiye: ek closed curve C aur region R ke liye theorem kaise kaam karti hai.
Green's Theorem line integral ko simplify karta hai by converting it into a double integral over region R.
Ab samajh gaye ki theorem ka main use kya hai? Ek chhota sawal karte hain!

check_question.question: Green's Theorem applies to which type of curve?
check_question.say: Green's Theorem kis type ke curve pe apply hoti hai?
check_question.explanation: Green's Theorem is valid only for closed curves enclosing a region.

steps.say: Ab hum Green's Theorem ko use karke ek line integral solve karenge circular path par.

draw.text: Solving Line Integrals Using Green's Theorem

steps.say: Vector field F diya hai: F equals sin y i plus x plus cos y j. Solve karte hain line integral F dot d r.

draw.text: F = sin y i + (x + cos y) j

steps.say: Green's Theorem kehta hai ki line integral ko double integral mein convert kar sakte hain.
Yaha P hai sin y aur Q hai x plus cos y. Ab derivatives nikalte hain.

draw.text: P = sin y, Q = x + cos y

steps.say: Double integral banega: ∬ (1 - cos y) dx dy. Solve karte hain region ke area ke liye.
Final answer hai π a², jo circle ke area ke equal hai. Green's Theorem se solve ho gaya.

check_question.question: What does Green's Theorem convert a line integral into?
check_question.say: Green's Theorem line integral ko kis mein convert karta hai?
check_question.explanation: Green's Theorem converts a line integral into a double integral over the enclosed region.

steps.say: Ab hum Green's Theorem ko verify karenge by solving ek problem using both line integral aur double integral.

draw.text: Verify Green's Theorem for circular path.

steps.say: Line integral solve karte hain vector field F dot d r ke liye. F diya hai: sin y i plus x plus cos y j.

draw.text: F = sin y i + (x + cos y) j

steps.say: Green's Theorem kehta hai ki line integral ko double integral mein convert kar sakte hain.

draw.text: P = sin y, Q = x + cos y

steps.say: Derivatives nikalte hain. ∂Q/∂x hai one aur ∂P/∂y hai cos y.

draw.text: Double integral: ∬ (1 - cos y) dx dy

steps.say: Region R circular hai, toh area of circle use karte hain. Answer hai π a².
Line integral aur double integral dono ka answer match karta hai: π a². Green's Theorem verified!

check_question.question: What does Green's Theorem verify in this example?
check_question.say: Green's Theorem kis cheez ko verify karta hai is example mein?
options: Area of circle is π a²
check_question.explanation: Green's Theorem converts line integral to double integral, and their results match.

steps.say: Ab hum Green's Theorem ko parabolic region ke liye apply karna seekhenge.

draw.text: Green's Theorem for a Parabolic Region

steps.say: Consider ek region jo do parabolas se bounded hai: y equals x square aur y square equals x.
Is region ke liye Green's Theorem ke hisaab se line integral ko double integral mein convert karte hain.
Yahaan P aur Q ke values hain P equals minus six x aur Q equals sixteen y.
Ab derivatives nikalte hain: del Q by del x zero hoga aur del P by del y bhi zero hoga.
To double integral ka result zero hoga, aur line integral bhi zero hai.

check_question.question: What is the result of the line integral ∮C P dx + Q dy for the region bounded by y = x² and y² = x?
check_question.say: Line integral ka result kya hoga region bounded by y equals x square aur y square equals x ke liye?
check_question.explanation: The double integral evaluates to zero, so the line integral is also zero by Green's Theorem.

steps.say: Ab hum Green's Theorem ko ek rectangular region ke liye apply karenge. Pehle title likh lete hain.

draw.text: Green's Theorem for a Rectangular Region

steps.say: Green's Theorem kehta hai ki line integral ko double integral mein convert kar sakte hain. Rectangular region ke liye isko samajhte hain.
Consider ek rectangle jo x equals zero se one aur y equals zero se one tak bounded hai. Diagram banate hain.
Ab hum vector field F consider karte hain: F equals x square i plus y square j. Yaha P hai x square aur Q hai y square.
Green's Theorem ke hisaab se, ∂Q/∂x aur ∂P/∂y nikalte hain. Dono zero hain, kyunki y aur x ke respect mein differentiation zero hai.
Agar ∂Q/∂x aur ∂P/∂y zero hain, toh double integral ka result bhi zero hoga. Line integral bhi zero hoga.
Iska matlab line integral aur double integral dono ke answers match karte hain. Green's Theorem verify hoti hai.

check_question.question: For a rectangular region 0 ≤ x ≤ 1, 0 ≤ y ≤ 1, and F = x² i + y² j, what is the value of the line integral ∮C F · dr?
check_question.say: Ek rectangular region ke liye, jisme x zero se one aur y zero se one hai, aur vector field F equals x square i plus y square j hai, line integral F dot d r ka value kya hoga?
check_question.explanation: Since ∂Q/∂x - ∂P/∂y is zero, the double integral and hence the line integral is also zero.
